item.command:
/bin/zsh -lc 'set -eu
bun --version
bunx tsc --noEmit --strict --target ES2022 --moduleResolution bundler --module preserve --types bun src/cli.ts
TEST_DIR="$(mktemp -d ./.selftest.XXXXXX)"
DB="$TEST_DIR/taskboard.json"
run() { TASKBOARD_FILE="$DB" bun run src/cli.ts "$@"; }
[ "$(run list)" = '"'[]' ]
A=\""'$(run add --title '"' First task ' --tags 'Work, work,URGENT' --due 2026-09-03)\"
B=\""'$(run add --title '"'Second' --tags personal --due 2026-09-05)\"
node -e 'const a=JSON.parse(process.argv[1]),b=JSON.parse(process.argv[2]); if(a.id"'!==1||a.title!=="First task"||a.status!=="open"||JSON.stringify(a.tags)!==JSON.stringify(["work","urgent"])||a.due!=="2026-09-03")process.exit(1);if(b.id!==2)process.exit(1)'"' \""'$A" "$B"
[ "$(run list --tag WORK)" = "[$A]" ]
[ "$(run list --overdue 2026-09-04)" = "[$A]" ]
D1="$(run done 1)"
D2="$(run done 1)"
node -e '"'const a=JSON.parse(process.argv[1]),b=JSON.parse(process.argv[2]); if(a.status"'!=="done"||!a.completedAt||a.completedAt!==b.completedAt)process.exit(1)'"' \""'$D1" "$D2"
[ "$(run list --status open)" = "[$B]" ]
S="$(run stats)"
node -e '"'const s=JSON.parse(process.argv[1]); if(s.total"'!==2||s.open!==1||s.done!==1||typeof s.overdue!=="number")process.exit(1)'"' \""'$S"
[ "$(run delete 2)" = "$B" ]
[ "$(run list)" = "[$D1]" ]
if run add --title '"'' >\""'$TEST_DIR/out" 2>"$TEST_DIR/err"; then exit 1; fi
node -e '"'JSON.parse(require(\"fs\").readFileSync(process.argv[1],\"utf8\"))' \""'$TEST_DIR/out"
if run add --title bad --due 2025-02-29 >"$TEST_DIR/out" 2>"$TEST_DIR/err"; then exit 1; fi
if run list --bogus >"$TEST_DIR/out" 2>"$TEST_DIR/err"; then exit 1; fi
cp "$DB" "$TEST_DIR/good.json"
printf '"'{bad' > \""'$DB"
if run list >"$TEST_DIR/out" 2>"$TEST_DIR/err"; then exit 1; fi
[ "$(cat "$DB")" = '"'{bad' ]
[ \""'$(find "$TEST_DIR" -name '"'taskboard.json.tmp-*' | wc -l | tr -d ' ')\" = 0 ]
printf 'self-tests passed\\n'
rm -rf \""'$TEST_DIR"'

item.command:
/bin/zsh -lc 'set -eu
export TMPDIR="$PWD/.tmp"
DB="$PWD/.tmp/error-cases.json"
BAD="$PWD/.tmp/malformed.json"
rm -f "$DB" "$DB.tmp" "$BAD" "$BAD.tmp"
run_fail() {
  out="$1"
  shift
  set +e
  TASKBOARD_FILE="$DB" bun run src/cli.ts "$@" >"$PWD/.tmp/$out.stdout" 2>"$PWD/.tmp/$out.stderr"
  code=$?
  set -e
  test "$code" -ne 0
  bun -e '"'JSON.parse(await Bun.file(process.argv[1]).text())' \""'$PWD/.tmp/$out.stdout"
  test -s "$PWD/.tmp/$out.stderr"
  test "$(wc -l < "$PWD/.tmp/$out.stdout" | tr -d '"' ')\" = 1
}
run_fail empty-title add --title '   '
run_fail bad-date add --title x --due 2026-02-30
run_fail missing-title add --tags x
run_fail unknown-command frobnicate
run_fail unknown-flag list --wat
run_fail bad-status list --status pending
run_fail bad-id done nope
run_fail missing-task delete 999
printf '%s' '{broken' > \""'$BAD"
BEFORE="$(shasum -a 256 "$BAD" | cut -d '"' ' -f 1)\"
set +e
TASKBOARD_FILE=\""'$BAD" bun run src/cli.ts list >"$PWD/.tmp/malformed.stdout" 2>"$PWD/.tmp/malformed.stderr"
CODE=$?
set -e
test "$CODE" -ne 0
bun -e '"'JSON.parse(await Bun.file(process.argv[1]).text())' \""'$PWD/.tmp/malformed.stdout"
test -s "$PWD/.tmp/malformed.stderr"
AFTER="$(shasum -a 256 "$BAD" | cut -d '"' ' -f 1)\"
test \""'$BEFORE" = "$AFTER"
test ! -e "$BAD.tmp"
printf '"'negative-path checks passed\\n'"
